verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the CLI docs' mention that you can "package repeatable instructions as skills." That offers a mechanism for reusable instructions, but it is not clearly a project-level instructions file that the agent automatically applies as coding standards and conventions. Missing for 10: documentation of a repository instructions file (e.g. its name, location and loading behavior), evidence that the agent follows conventions defined in it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
